rows.title: Task: Compare land cover change
rows.task_full:
Task: Compare land cover change
Compare land cover changes between two time periods (2014 and 2021) using surface reflectance data from Landsat 8, selecting cloud-minimized images within August for both years, clipping to a study area, and visualizing them with a false-color composite. The analysis focuses on areas sampled by stratified random points based on an NDVI threshold of -100, indicating potential land cover change or barren surfaces.

rows.title: Task: Map dry season land cover
rows.task_full:
Task: Map dry season land cover
Map land surface conditions during the dry season across six time points (1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020) using Landsat surface reflectance imagery. It applies cloud and shadow masking via pixel_qa band, computes median composites for the January–March dry season, clips to a user-defined area, and visualizes results in true and false color. Outputs include six clipped median composite images exported to Google Drive and displayed on the map with appropriate band rendering (B4/B3/B2 for OLI, B3/B2/B1 for TM/ETM+).

rows.title: Task: Identify seasonal NDVI patterns
rows.task_full:
Task: Identify seasonal NDVI patterns
Analyze seasonal vegetation dynamics using Sentinel-2 NDVI imagery over a specific region. It computes mean NDVI for three time periods (early, mid, and late season) from 2021 to 2022, applies threshold-based classification to identify moderate-to-high vegetation cover in each period, and combines the results to detect areas with consistent seasonal vegetation patterns. Outputs include binary maps of NDVI thresholds, their intersection displayed on the map, and histograms of NDVI values for each period over sug.union(), supporting phenological analysis.

rows.title: Task: Map monthly water extent
rows.task_full:
Task: Map monthly water extent
Compute monthly minimum composite images from Sentinel-2 for India in 2018, calculates NDWI using Green (B3) and NIR (B8) bands, applies dynamic thresholds to classify water bodies each month, masks non-water areas, and estimates the area of surface water per month in square kilometers. It outputs a time series of monthly water extent maps, binary water masks, and a list of monthly water areas for analysis.

rows.title: Task: Compare tree cover agreement at multiple thresholds
rows.task_full:
Task: Compare tree cover agreement at multiple thresholds
the workflow evaluates the agreement and disagreement between a user-defined tree cover classification (myTreeCover) and the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset's tree cover for the year 2000, using four different threshold values (31%, 32%, 33%, 34%). It computes multi-threshold comparisons via a custom tool function, then calculates pixel counts of agreement/disagreement classes within a clipped study region (Rumphi District Landscape in Malawi). The output consists of four bar charts showing the magnitude of agreement/disagreement (i

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover in Harare
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover in Harare
Classify land cover types in Harare using a CART decision tree classifier trained on spectral bands from Landsat 5 TOA imagery from the year 2000. It outputs a classified map of five categories—water, agriculture, urban, forestry, and wetlands—clipped to the Harare boundary.

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover types in a region of Argentina using multi-temporal Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery from October 2021 to May 2022. It computes spectral indices (NDVI, NDVIre, MSAVI, TCARI, NDWI, GCVI) for each time point and combines them into a composite. Urban areas are masked out using a feature collection. A Random Forest classifier is trained on labeled samples to classify land cover, with accuracy assessed via confusion matrix and user/productor accuracy. Outputs include a classified land cover map, validation metrics, variable importance scores

rows.title: Task: Analyze ARVI vegetation index
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze ARVI vegetation index
Compute the Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index (ARVI) from Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery over a specific region across multiple seasonal periods between 2018 and 2020. It applies cloud masking using the QA60 band, filters images by date and cloud cover, calculates ARVI using bands B2 (blue), B4 (red), and B8 (NIR), and clips results to the study area. The output includes ARVI rasters for different time periods (e.g., Jan-April, Kering/dry season), their min/max/mean statistics within the region, and visualizations and exports of key ARVI com

rows.title: Task: Fill Landsat gaps in summer imagery
rows.task_full:
Task: Fill Landsat gaps in summer imagery
Generate a gap-filled median composite of Landsat 8 OLI surface reflectance bands (B2–B7) for the summer season (January–March 2020) over the Caldenal region, using progressively wider temporal composites to fill missing data due to cloud cover, and exports the final filled image to a GEE asset.

rows.title: Task: Compute EVI from Sentinel-2 imagery
rows.task_full:
Task: Compute EVI from Sentinel-2 imagery
Calculate the Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) from Sentinel-2A/B Surface Reflectance data over a region of interest for four overlapping weekly periods in March 2020. It applies cloud and cirrus masking using the QA60 band, filters images by low cloud cover (<10%), computes EVI using blue (B2), red (B4), and near-infrared (B8) bands scaled by 10,000, then generates a median composite of EVI for each period. The output includes mapped visualizations with a color palette and exports GeoTIFFs of mean EVI to Google Drive at 20m resolution clipped to the st

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI change in Algeria
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI change in Algeria
Analyze temporal changes in vegetation condition in Algeria by computing median NDVI from NOAA AVHRR data for two time periods: 1985 and 2018. It calculates mean and variance of NDVI at the country level using reduceRegions, extracts per-image statistics over Algeria, removes geometries for efficient export, and exports both mean and variance as CSV tables. Additionally, it visualizes and exports median NDVI rasters clipped to Algeria and Steppe land regions. The outputs include mapped NDVI layers, printed feature collections, and exported CSVs and GeoTIFFs

rows.title: Task: Analyze annual precipitation patterns
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze annual precipitation patterns
Calculate total annual precipitation from CHIRPS daily rainfall data for each year between 2010 and 2020 over a specified region. It computes yearly cumulative rainfall using image collection reduction (sum), visualizes the total precipitation on the map with a white-to-blue color palette, and generates time series column charts of mean daily precipitation aggregated over the region for each year. Outputs include mapped total precipitation layers for 2010–2012 and printed charts for 2010–2020.

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover using multispectral and texture features
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover using multispectral and texture features
Generate a multi-temporal, multi-source Earth observation dataset for land cover classification over a specific MGRS tile. It processes Landsat 5 and 8 surface reflectance imagery from three years (target year, previous, and next) across four seasonal periods (Q1–Q4), computes NDVI time series, extracts GLCM texture metrics (contrast, ASM, correlation, variance, dissimilarity, IDM) from NIR band, and integrates elevation, slope, and aspect from SRTM. The outputs are four GeoTIFFs exported to Google Drive: (1) median seasonal sp

rows.title: Task: Analyze SST time series
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze SST time series
Extract sea surface temperature (SST) values from the NOAA CDR OISST dataset over a user-defined region of interest (roi) for the period 2010–2021, computes mean SST values per image via reduction over the roi, and generates a time-series scatter chart of SST in degrees Celsius. It also exports the resulting time-series data to Google Drive as a CSV file and visualizes the SST imagery on the map with a custom color palette.

rows.title: Task: Analyze land cover change
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze land cover change
Analyze land surface changes over a study area using Landsat 8 TOA reflectance imagery from 2013, 2016, and 2020. It applies cloud masking via the BQA band, computes median composites for each year, and clips them to a user-defined boundary (shp). Visualizations are generated using a false-color composite (SWIR2, NIR, Red) to highlight land cover differences across time. Additionally, terrain analysis is performed using SRTM DEM data, including slope and hillshade generation, to support topographic context. Outputs include three false-colored Landsat image layer

rows.title: Task: Extract VV backscatter time series
rows.task_full:
Task: Extract VV backscatter time series
Compute temporal statistics of Sentinel-1 C-band VV polarization backscatter from descending orbit observations over a user-defined geometry for the year 2021. It divides the year into 24 biweekly intervals, calculates the mean VV intensity for each period, and compiles them into a multi-band image. For each feature in an input shapefile (e.g., agricultural parcels), it extracts the mean VV values using reduceRegion and exports the resulting feature collection with these statistics to Google Drive as a table.

rows.title: Task: Compare recent land surface changes
rows.task_full:
Task: Compare recent land surface changes
the workflow retrieves and visualizes Sentinel-2 surface reflectance composites from different recent time windows (last 2 weeks, 2–4 weeks ago, 4–6 weeks ago, and a reference from January 2019) over specific beach locations. It enables interactive comparison of least cloudy images across these periods using a split-panel map interface with layer selectors and location presets. The output consists of four RGB visualizations (B4, B3, B2) for temporal visual analysis of land surface changes, particularly focusing on coastal or beach areas in Zimbabwe.

rows.title: Task: Analyze surface water extent using NDWI
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze surface water extent using NDWI
Compute the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) from Sentinel-2 imagery for three consecutive years (2019–2021) during April, and again for the following month (May), using cloud-masked, median-composited images. It visualizes the resulting water surfaces over a region of interest, with emphasis on detecting changes in surface water extent through time using greenness in the shortwave infrared and green bands.

rows.title: Task: Calculate annual CUE from GPP and NPP
rows.task_full:
Task: Calculate annual CUE from GPP and NPP
Calculate the Carbon Use Efficiency (CUE) by combining annual NPP from MOD17A3HGF and 8-day GPP from MOD17A2H across 2000–2021. It computes CUE as (NPP/365*8)/GPP for each pixel, masks results to non-urban/non-water land cover types (LC_Type1 < 7) within a specified region of interest (roi), and outputs a time-series image collection of CUE with visualization applied. The final result is clipped and displayed on the map.

rows.title: Task: Map land cover changes
rows.task_full:
Task: Map land cover changes
Generate median composite images from Landsat 5, 7, and 8 surface reflectance data for three different time periods (1986, 2010, 2020) over a user-defined geometry, applying masking for cloud and saturation artifacts. It visualizes the resulting composites in the map interface, enabling temporal comparison of land surface conditions. The final export is a feature collection asset named 'mer_thywill2', likely representing classified or labeled training samples for land cover classes such as water, urban, and vegetation.

rows.title: Task: Analyze surface temperature trends
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze surface temperature trends
Analyze land surface temperature trends in Surakarta from 2013 to 2022 using thermal infrared bands from Landsat 7 and Landsat 8, generating true-color composites, time-series temperature charts in Celsius, and mapped surface temperature visualizations.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI change in mangroves
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI change in mangroves
Analyze changes in NDVI over a coastal region, focusing on mangrove areas, using Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery from two dry seasons (2020 and 2021). It applies cloud masking, computes spectral indices including NDVI, and generates median composites for each period. The difference in NDVI between the two periods is calculated and visualized, with specific emphasis on the mangrove zone using a custom boundary. Outputs include a difference raster map of NDVI (2021 - 2020) over the full area and within mangroves, supporting change detection in vegeta

rows.title: Task: Generate cloud-masked mosaic of Sentinel-2 surface reflectance
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate cloud-masked mosaic of Sentinel-2 surface reflectance
Create a cloud-free mosaic from Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance images over a specific region in Indonesia by applying QA-based cloud and cirrus masking using the QA60 band. It filters images by date and cloud cover, applies the maskS2clouds function to remove cloudy pixels, reduces each date-specific collection to the first non-null pixel values, clips to the region of interest, and mosaics three temporal composites (date2, date3, date1) in reverse chronological priority. The output is a composite RGB visualization and indivi

rows.title: Task: Monitor annual NDBI trends
rows.task_full:
Task: Monitor annual NDBI trends
Compute the annual mean Normalized Difference Built-up Index (NDBI) over Hulunbeier from 1986 to 2020 using Landsat surface reflectance data. It processes Landsat 5, 7, and 8 imagery by standardizing band names, applying pixel quality masking via 'pixel_qa' to retain only clear observations, calculating NDBI as (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR), and generating a yearly median composite per region. The output is an ImageCollection of annual NDBI images and a time series chart showing median NDBI values over the region, enabling long-term built-up land change analysis.

rows.title: Task: Analyze monthly evapotranspiration dynamics
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze monthly evapotranspiration dynamics
Compute monthly average evapotranspiration (ET) over the Tempisque-Bebedero Basin using MODIS MOD16A2 data for the year 2016. It processes each month separately by filtering the image collection to specific date ranges, calculating mean ET values, and clipping to a user-defined polygon. The results are visualized on the map with customized color palettes per month. Upon user click, a time series chart of ET at that location is generated using ui.Chart.image.regions, showing monthly ET variation across the year. Additionally, an irrigation layer

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover using time-series indices
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover using time-series indices
Classify land cover types using a multi-temporal Sentinel-2 surface reflectance dataset from May to January. It computes spectral indices (NDVI, SAVI, NDWI, GCVI) for each time step, combines them into a composite image, and applies a Random Forest classifier trained on labeled samples. The output includes a classified land cover map, accuracy assessment metrics (confusion matrix, overall accuracy, kappa, user/producer accuracy), variable importance scores, and export of results to Drive.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI over time
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI over time
Analyze temporal changes in NDVI within a user-defined region of interest (ROI) using Landsat 8 surface reflectance imagery from January 1, 2016, to April 6, 2019. It computes NDVI by applying normalizedDifference on bands B5 and B4 for each image in the filtered collection, then generates two time series charts: one aggregated over the ROI feature collection and another at a specific point location. The outputs are two printed UI charts showing NDVI trends over time, enabling comparison of vegetation dynamics at different spatial supports.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI temporal signature
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI temporal signature
Compute and visualizes the monthly NDVI time series from Landsat 8 TOA data over a user-defined study area (AreaEst) from May 2018 to April 2019, generating median composite images for each month with cloud masking using BQA, and compares the NDVI temporal profile with MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI data over the same period.

rows.title: Task: Generate cloud-free Sentinel-2 composites
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate cloud-free Sentinel-2 composites
Generate cloud-free median composite images of Kenya using Sentinel-2 surface reflectance data from 2015 to 2020. It applies cloud and cirrus masking via the QA60 band, filters images by date and cloud coverage, computes median pixel values across collections for each year, clips results to the Kenya boundary, and visualizes or exports RGB (B4, B3, B2) composites. Outputs include six annual cloud-cleared mosaics for visual analysis and export to Google Drive.

rows.title: Task: Analyze tropospheric NO2 levels
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze tropospheric NO2 levels
Analyze monthly tropospheric NO2 column number density over a defined geometry from January 2019 to December 2021 using Sentinel-5P NRTI data. It computes monthly mean composites, masks values below zero, visualizes spatial patterns with a color palette, generates a scatter chart of temporal trends across 36 months, and exports the last six months (July–December 2021) as GeoTIFFs to Google Drive for further analysis.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI from Landsat
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI from Landsat
Calculate and masks NDVI values from top-of-atmosphere (TOA) Landsat 8 imagery over a specific region, applying cloud filtering (cloud score ≤ 20), and computes the mean NDVI image across the time period. The output is a single mean NDVI image and a list of image IDs from the filtered collection.

rows.title: Task: Generate cloud-masked Landsat mosaics
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate cloud-masked Landsat mosaics
Generate median composite mosaics from Landsat 8 surface reflectance data for specific WRS-2 paths and a user-defined region, applying cloud masking using QA bands and custom functions, then clips and visualizes true-color composites for multiple path/row combinations over a defined region in 2017.

rows.title: Task: Analyze salinity stress in vegetation
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze salinity stress in vegetation
Calculate and visualizes three different NSI (Normalized Soil Index or similar salinity/vegetation stress indices) from Landsat imagery over a region defined by geometry_R1 for multiple years (2020, 2015, 2010, 2005, 2000, 1993), applying cloud masking and temporal compositing. The output consists of mapped layers styled with an SLD-defined color ramp to indicate varying levels of salinity stress, suggesting the purpose is long-term monitoring of vegetation salinity stress using multispectral indices.

rows.title: Task: Detect wildfire impact using dNBR2
rows.task_full:
Task: Detect wildfire impact using dNBR2
Detect wildfire impacts in central Thailand by computing the difference in Normalized Burn Ratio Version 2 (dNBR2) from Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery before and after a fire event. It applies cloud masking to pre- and post-fire image collections, computes NBR2 using SWIR bands (B11 and B12), calculates dNBR2 as the subtraction of post-fire NBR2 from pre-fire NBR2, and exports the resulting dNBR2 raster for change analysis. The output is a continuous geospatial layer highlighting burn severity, which is visualized with a color palette and export

rows.title: Task: Classify agricultural land cover
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify agricultural land cover
Classify agricultural land cover in a region of Argentina using multi-temporal Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery from October 2021 to May 2022. It computes spectral indices (NDVI, NDVIre, MSAVI, TCARI, NDWI, GCVI) across eight time composites and combines them with reflectance bands to form a high-dimensional feature space. Urban areas are masked using a PlantaUrbana shapefile. A Random Forest classifier is trained on labeled samples (CLASE) from 'Verdad_BUE_Gr2122_Saliquello', validated with test data, and applied to generate a classified land cover

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover change
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover change
Classify land use and land cover (LULC) for the years 2010 and 2020 using Landsat imagery, trains a Random Forest classifier on labeled regions of interest, validates classification accuracy with confusion matrices, and computes LULC change between the two periods. Outputs include classified LULC maps for 2010 and 2020, accuracy assessments, and a change map visualized with custom palettes.

rows.title: Task: Assess wildfire burn severity
rows.task_full:
Task: Assess wildfire burn severity
the workflow assesses wildfire burn severity for the 'WITCH' fire using dNBR and RBR indices derived from Landsat TOA reflectance data. It computes pre-fire, year-of-fire, and year-after-fire NBR using median composites of cloud-masked imagery within the fire boundary. The dNBR and RBR are calculated to quantify burn severity, and the results are exported as GeoTIFFs for further analysis.

rows.title: Task: Analyze CO column density
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze CO column density
Analyze carbon monoxide (CO) column number density from Sentinel-5P satellite data over a specific region for multiple monthly periods across 2018–2021. It computes median, mean, and variance of CO levels, visualizes the median values on a map using a color palette, and exports mean and variance statistics per region to CSV files via Google Drive. The workflow involves filtering an ImageCollection by date, applying spatial clipping, reducing image data over regions using mean and variance reducers, and exporting tabular results.

rows.title: Task: Analyze vegetation change over time
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze vegetation change over time
Compute the difference in NDVI between the years 2000 and 2018 using Landsat 7 TOA reflectance data over the Rohingya region. It calculates annual mean NDVI for each year by applying normalizedDifference on bands B4 and B3, clips to the study area, and subtracts the 2018 image from the 2000 image to generate a change map. The output is a continuous raster layer visualizing temporal changes in vegetation greenness, added to the map with a specified visualization palette.

rows.title: Task: Analyze precipitation changes
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze precipitation changes
Analyze temporal and spatial patterns of precipitation over Isfahan, Iran, using multiple satellite-based rainfall datasets (TRMM/3B43V7, CHIRPS/DAILY, and GPM_L3/IMERG_MONTHLY). It computes time-series charts of mean precipitation using region reduction (ee.Reducer.mean()) over the city boundary, visualizes the data via Map layers, and exports both image collections and tabular time-series data (as CSV) for external use. The workflow includes filtering by date and region, unit conversion (multiplying by 30.0 to adjust units), clipping, band selection, and e

rows.title: Task: Identify burned area extent
rows.task_full:
Task: Identify burned area extent
Identify burned areas in the Beira Corridor region using Landsat imagery from 2013 to 2019. It processes collections of Landsat 7 and 8 surface reflectance images, applying a threshold on the near-infrared band (B5 for Landsat 8, B4 for Landsat 7) to detect potential burned pixels. Annual burned area layers are generated by summing binary masks across images per year, then applying a frequency threshold. A final cumulative burned area map from 2014 to 2019 is produced by combining annual binary burned area rasters. Outputs include annual and total burned area

rows.title: Task: Classify agricultural land cover
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify agricultural land cover
Classify land cover types in an agricultural region using multi-temporal Sentinel-2 surface reflectance data from 2020 to 2022. It computes spectral indices (NDVI, NDVIre, MSAVI, TCARI, NDWI, GCVI) across eight time points, combines them into a composite image, masks urban areas, and applies a Random Forest classifier trained on ground truth data with 10-fold cross-validation. The output includes a classified land cover map, accuracy assessment metrics (confusion matrix, overall accuracy, Kappa, user/producer accuracies), variable importance scores, and e

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI and NDMI vegetation indices
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI and NDMI vegetation indices
Compute NDVI and NDMI vegetation and moisture indices from surface reflectance data of Landsat 5, 8, and 9 over a watershed area, applying cloud masking and band scaling to generate time-series image collections for vegetation analysis.

rows.title: Task: Generate cloud-free Sentinel-2 mosaic
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate cloud-free Sentinel-2 mosaic
Create two cloud-free median composites from Sentinel-2 Level-1C imagery for October–November 2020 and April–May 2020, masks clouds using QA60 band, clips to a specified geometry, and exports the October composite with selected bands (B11, B8, B4, B12) as a GeoTIFF asset.

rows.title: Task: Analyze vegetation and land surface properties
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze vegetation and land surface properties
Analyze vegetation and land surface conditions over a region using Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery from two different time periods. It computes NDVI, NDR, and EVI indices to assess vegetation health and surface characteristics, applies cloud masking and median reduction to generate composites, and visualizes results as RGB and index maps. Outputs include exported raster assets for RGB composites (2019 and 2020), NDR (2019), and EVI.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI anomaly for agricultural drought
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI anomaly for agricultural drought
Calculate NDVI anomalies for April of multiple years (2009–2019) by comparing MODIS MYD13Q1 and MOD13Q1 data against a long-term mean, identifying vegetation deviations likely related to drought conditions, and exports anomaly maps for specific years. It also overlays agricultural damage zones (e.g., rapeseed and wheat) in Csongrád county, Hungary, to assess spatial correlation with vegetation stress.

rows.title: Task: Analyze VH backscatter temporal pattern
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze VH backscatter temporal pattern
Compute mean VV and VH polarized radar backscatter from Sentinel-1 GRD data over a geometry for each 15-day period throughout 2020, specifically selecting descending orbit passes. It aggregates these into a multi-band image where each band represents the mean VH value per bi-monthly interval. Then, it extracts regional statistics (mean) of these VH values for each feature in a shapefile using reduceRegion, and exports the resulting feature collection with added VH metrics to Google Drive as 'VHDes2020'.

rows.title: Task: Compare land surface changes
rows.task_full:
Task: Compare land surface changes
Analyze land surface changes over time using multispectral imagery from different decades. It processes Landsat 2 imagery from May 1976 and October 1975, and Sentinel-2 SR imagery from May and September 2020, applying cloud filtering and band selection for visualization. The key workflow includes filtering image collections by date, path/row, and cloud cover, selecting spectral bands (B4, B5, B6 for Landsat; B2, B3, B4 for Sentinel-2), and generating maximum value composites. Outputs are four visual layers added to the map: 'October 1975', 'May 1976', 'May 20

rows.title: Task: Classify agricultural land cover
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify agricultural land cover
Classify agricultural and natural land cover types in Córdoba, Argentina using a time series of Sentinel-2 surface reflectance images. It computes NDVI for multiple temporal composites (quality mosaics based on NDVI), stacks them into a multi-temporal spectral dataset, and applies unsupervised clustering (K-means) to derive land cover classes. The resulting clusters are reclassified into broad categories (cultivated vs non-cultivated) and visualized with custom color palettes. Training samples are extracted from a defined geometry, and outputs include cla

rows.title: Task: Analyze NO2 levels over time
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NO2 levels over time
Extract and analyzes nitrogen dioxide (NO2) column number density from Sentinel-5P satellite data over 16 different geographic regions (table to table16) between 2018 and 2023, computing mean, maximum, and minimum values within each region per image date, and generating time-series charts for each location.

rows.title: Task: Generate cloud-free Landsat composite
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate cloud-free Landsat composite
Create a cloud-free median composite of Landsat 8 surface reflectance imagery over the Delaware region from June to August 2020. It applies a pixel quality-based cloud and cloud shadow mask using the 'pixel_qa' band, computes a simple composite using median reduction, and exports the resulting RGB (B4, B3, B2) image to Google Drive. The output is a natural-color composite image suitable for visual interpretation and land cover analysis.

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover types in the Buenos Aires province using median-composite Landsat 8 TOA reflectance data from 2016, trained with user-defined polygons and validated with independent validation points. The output is a classified image map showing urban, water, pasture, agriculture (two classes), forest plantations, and delta areas, along with an accuracy assessment including confusion matrix, overall accuracy, and producer/user accuracies.

rows.title: Task: Estimate fractional vegetation cover
rows.task_full:
Task: Estimate fractional vegetation cover
Calculate the Red Vegetation Index (RVI) and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) from Landsat 5 TOA reflectance data to estimate fractional vegetation cover (FC) in the Distrito Federal, Brazil. It computes statistics (mean and standard deviation) of FC per administrative region (SPRCLASSE) and exports both the NDVI image and the regional FC statistics to Google Drive.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI temporal trends in APP areas
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI temporal trends in APP areas
Analyze the temporal behavior of NDVI in Areas of Permanent Preservation (APP) labeled 'Recuperar' using Landsat surface reflectance imagery (TM, ETM+, and OLI) from 1984 to 2019. It standardizes band names across sensors, applies Fmask-based cloud and cloud shadow masking, converts ETM+ and TM reflectance to OLI-like values using linear regression coefficients, computes NDVI, extracts median NDVI values within the APP polygons at 30m scale, and generates both a yearly median composite time series and a full temporal stack. Outputs include a prin

rows.title: Task: Generate cloud-free RGB composite
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate cloud-free RGB composite
Create a median cloud-free RGB composite image from Sentinel-2 data collected between May 15 and May 28, 2017, masking clouds and cirrus using the QA60 band, then visualizes it with reflectance values scaled to 0.3 max in red, green, and blue bands.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI over time
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI over time
Analyze vegetation dynamics in a specified region using NDVI derived from Sentinel-2 imagery between March and October for the years 2016 to 2021. It applies cloud masking using the QA60 band, computes NDVI using bands B8 and B4, and generates a time-series line chart of mean NDVI values across multiple regions (all_ID_10). Additionally, it calculates the median NDVI composite over the period and displays it on the map, clipped to a defined geometry, with a color palette reflecting vegetation density.

rows.title: Task: Map annual rainfall distribution
rows.task_full:
Task: Map annual rainfall distribution
Calculate the total annual precipitation for 2009 using CHIRPS pentad data, visualizes it with a custom color palette, and adds a gradient legend to the map. It also creates a median composite of Landsat 8 TOA reflectance images from 2013–2019 over a specific WRS path/row, applies scaling and type conversion, and displays the result. Additionally, it sets up video export of the Landsat collection over a defined region. Two legends are created: one categorical (unused) and one continuous for rainfall.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI at point
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI at point
Calculate NDVI at a specific geographic point using the least cloudy Landsat 8 image from a one-year period. It retrieves the top-of-atmosphere reflectance imagery, computes NDVI using near-infrared (B5) and red (B4) bands, visualizes the NDVI with a custom color palette, and computes the mean NDVI value over the point using reduceRegion. The output includes a map layer of NDVI and a dictionary containing the mean NDVI value.

rows.title: Task: Analyze nighttime light intensity
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze nighttime light intensity
Analyze the spatial distribution and intensity of nighttime lights in the state of Goiás, Brazil, using DMSP-OLS satellite data for the years 1992, 2010, and 2013. It generates mean composite images of visible band radiance (avg_vis) for each year, clipped to the Goiás boundary, and visualizes them on the map with a custom color palette to show urbanization and human activity patterns over time.

rows.title: Task: Generate cloud-cleared Sentinel-2 RGB composite
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate cloud-cleared Sentinel-2 RGB composite
Generate a median true-color (RGB) composite image from Sentinel-2A/B Surface Reflectance data over a specified region between January and June 2020. It applies cloud and cirrus masking using the QA60 band, filters images with less than 20% cloud coverage, and composites the remaining pixels by taking the mean value. The output is a visually interpretable RGB layer displayed on the map with reflectance values scaled between 0.0 and 0.3 for bands B4, B3, and B2.

rows.title: Task: Estimate chlorophyll-a concentration
rows.task_full:
Task: Estimate chlorophyll-a concentration
Estimate chlorophyll-a (Chla) concentration in water bodies using a linear regression model applied to surface reflectance band 4 (red) from Landsat 8 and 9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance data. The output is a mean Chla image over the specified time period, masked for clouds and saturation, visualized with a blue-white-green palette and exported as a GeoTIFF.

rows.title: Task: Classify urban land cover
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify urban land cover
Classify urban land cover in Odesa using Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery from May 2022. It applies cloud masking, clips the image to a study area, trains a Random Forest classifier using labeled regions (urban, various, disrupted), and generates a classified land cover map. Accuracy is assessed using a holdout validation method with an error matrix and overall accuracy printed. Additionally, NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) is computed and exported alongside the classified map and original RGB-clipped image for further analysis.

rows.title: Task: Extract NDWI and Landsat composites
rows.task_full:
Task: Extract NDWI and Landsat composites
Analyze surface water and vegetation conditions in a specific region using Landsat 7 and Landsat 8 surface reflectance imagery from 2002, 2016, and 2021. It applies cloud masking using pixel quality bands, computes NDVI and NDWI indices, generates median composite images for each period, and exports the composites to Google Drive as GeoTIFFs for change analysis over time.

rows.title: Task: Extract NDVI time series for fields
rows.task_full:
Task: Extract NDVI time series for fields
Calculate NDVI values over agricultural fields by extracting near-infrared (B8) and red (B4) reflectance from Sentinel-2 imagery between 2016-07-01 and 2016-08-15. It computes mean NDVI per field using reduceRegions with a feature collection of field geometries, maps the date of each image to the results, and exports a flattened table of NDVI values with corresponding dates as a CSV file for external analysis.

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover types using Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery from February 2020 over a specified region of interest (roi). It applies cloud masking using the QA60 band to remove pixels affected by clouds and cirrus, computes a median composite, and trains a Random Forest classifier using labeled training samples (urban, water, forest, fallowland, others, crop) on bands B2, B3, B4, and B8. The output includes a classified land cover map, training and validation accuracy assessments via confusion matrices, overall accuracy, kappa coefficient, and produce

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover types using Landsat 8 surface reflectance imagery from April to September 2020. It applies cloud and shadow masking using the pixel_qa band, computes NDVI and MNDWI indices, and trains a CART classifier on labeled training samples (Builtup, vegetation, bare, waterbody, aquaculture) to generate a land cover classification map. The output is a classified raster with five land cover classes visualized with distinct colors and displayed over the study area.

rows.title: Task: Classify urban and land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify urban and land cover types
Classify land cover types in a Sentinel-2 grid tile using NDVI time-series composites derived from surface reflectance imagery collected over 2021. It computes median NDVI for six bimonthly periods, combines them into a multi-band image, and applies Random Forest classification trained on user-defined sample regions (Forest, VegetationG, VegetationC, Urban, Soil, Water). The output is a classified raster map with six land cover classes visualized with a custom color palette.

rows.title: Task: Analyze annual ET accumulation
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze annual ET accumulation
Calculate and visualizes annual and monthly evapotranspiration (ET) accumulation over a defined study area using MODIS MOD16A2 data from 2001 to 2020. It processes the ET band by filtering, mosaicking, scaling by 0.1, and applying visualization parameters. The workflow includes generating time-series charts of mean annual ET via region-based reduction and creating individual layers for specific years (2001–2003) and months (e.g., January 2001). Outputs include mapped ET layers, a legend UI panel for visualization, and a column chart showing annual ET trends

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover types for a region in southern India using a Random Forest classifier trained on MODIS-derived land cover labels and Landsat 8 surface reflectance bands. It produces an upsampled land cover map at 30m resolution, clips it to a specific administrative boundary (DK), and exports the classified image to Google Drive.

rows.title: Task: Map surface water recurrence
rows.task_full:
Task: Map surface water recurrence
Analyze surface water dynamics in the XJ region using the JRC Global Surface Water dataset. It visualizes the monthly recurrence of surface water from 2021-07 to 2021-09, derived from Sentinel-2 SR imagery filtered for low cloud cover. The output includes a composite Sentinel-2 RGB image and a thematic map showing water occurrence frequency, enabling assessment of persistent vs. seasonal water bodies.

rows.title: Task: Analyze annual precipitation accumulation
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze annual precipitation accumulation
Calculate annual accumulated precipitation and potential evapotranspiration (PET) from TerraClimate data between 2000 and 2022 for a specified AOI. It generates time series charts of mean yearly precipitation and PET, displays the long-term average precipitation on a map, and creates an animated GIF showing yearly precipitation with overlaid year labels. A custom color bar is added to the map for visual interpretation of precipitation values.

rows.title: Task: Extract multispectral values at sample polygons
rows.task_full:
Task: Extract multispectral values at sample polygons
Extract multispectral band values (B2 to B11) from a mosaicked Landsat 8 TOA image for specific polygon regions defined in a KML-based feature collection, applying cloud and shadow masking, and exports the results as a CSV file containing spectral reflectance and thermal values per region.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI time series
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI time series
Analyze the temporal dynamics of vegetation in two agricultural fields, Kulkurna A and B, using NDVI derived from Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery between 2013 and 2019. It applies cloud masking using the SCL band to remove low, medium, high clouds, and shadows, then computes NDVI using bands B8 and B4. The output includes median NDVI composite visualization and interactive scatter charts showing mean NDVI over time for each field, with trendlines, enabling comparison of vegetation health trends between the two regions.

rows.title: Task: Classify wetland vegetation types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify wetland vegetation types
Classify wetland land cover types using Sentinel-2 time-series imagery, salinity data, and a training raster derived from CCAP FIBS, producing a mode-combined classification map for coastal Louisiana between 2016 and 2022.

rows.title: Task: Generate seasonal VV composites
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate seasonal VV composites
Create median composite images of Sentinel-1 VV polarization backscatter across three seasonal periods in 2018 and visualizes them as a false-color seasonal composite. It also displays median VV and VH backscatter intensity maps over the region of interest.

rows.title: Task: Calculate THI from air temperature
rows.task_full:
Task: Calculate THI from air temperature
Calculate the Temperature-Humidity Index (THI) using daily maximum and mean 2m air temperature and dewpoint temperature from ERA5. It converts Kelvin to Celsius, computes relative humidity indirectly, and applies a THI formula involving temperature and humidity components. A linear regression trend is then fitted over time to the THI time series, and the slope (rate of change) is exported as a global raster. The output is a map of THI trend intensity (slope) at 30,000 m resolution over continental boundaries.

rows.title: Task: Identify surface water occurrence frequency
rows.task_full:
Task: Identify surface water occurrence frequency
Analyze annual surface water dynamics using SWSC (Surface Water Seasonal Cycle) and NDPI (Normalized Difference Pond Index) datasets from MapBiomas AGUA, computing frequency of occurrence over time (1985–2018). It visualizes mosaicked Landsat composites, classified water extent, and cumulative frequency layers in a split-panel interactive map with a time-series chart for year selection. Users can toggle visibility of SWSC and frequency layers and search by map grid ('carta').

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI temporal trends
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI temporal trends
Compute and visualizes median NDVI from Sentinel-2 and Landsat (L8, L5) imagery over a specific region, generating time series charts at sample points and exporting median NDVI composites for three periods: 1984–2002 (Landsat 5), 2013–2014 (Landsat 8), and 2015–2020 (Sentinel-2).

rows.title: Task: Extract water bodies using NDWI
rows.task_full:
Task: Extract water bodies using NDWI
Identify water bodies in a specified region using the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) derived from Landsat 7 TOA reflectance imagery between 2002 and 2003. It applies cloud masking, mosaics the image collection by computing the mean, fills gaps using a focal mean filter, blends with original data, and computes NDWI based on B4 and B5 bands. The output is a water index raster map exported as GeoTIFF and visualized with a custom palette to highlight water features.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI GNDVI NDRE time series
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI GNDVI NDRE time series
Analyze vegetation dynamics over a field using NDVI, GNDVI, and NDRE indices derived from Sentinel-2 imagery between 2016 and 2020. It computes mean and standard deviation of vegetation indices at three specific locations (Width, Length, Center) within the field, generates scatter charts for temporal patterns, and visualizes maximum NDVI over the field. The outputs include multiple time-series scatter plots (mean and stdDev per index), a mapped NDVI layer, and printed metadata such as field area, perimeter, and centroid coordinates.

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover in Pantanal
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover in Pantanal
Generate a time-series land cover classification map for the Pantanal biome from 1985 to 2021 using MapBiomas Collection 7. It combines multiple regional classification images (reg1–reg7), applies post-classification blending and remapping (e.g., merging pasture and natural grasslands), integrates agricultural masks derived from sample points, and corrects classifications using reference data. The output is a unified multi-band image asset where each band represents the classified land cover for a specific year, exported to Google Earth Engine with metadat

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover types using Sentinel-2 surface reflectance data, applying a Random Forest classifier trained on labeled polygons. It generates a confusion matrix and exports test accuracy metrics to a CSV file for validation of classification performance.

rows.title: Task: Detect land cover change using Sentinel-1 VV
rows.task_full:
Task: Detect land cover change using Sentinel-1 VV
Detect changes in land cover or surface structure over a development area using temporal differences in Sentinel-1 VV backscatter. It identifies the most recent image, filters the collection by orbit and relative orbit number, computes the difference between maximum and minimum VV values over time, masks non-land areas using the Hansen global forest change data mask, and visualizes the change intensity. Outputs include a change intensity map, a median S1 composite, a time-series line chart of median VV values over the region (if a polygon is p

rows.title: Task: Analyze forest vegetation index trends
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze forest vegetation index trends
Analyze temporal trends of NDVI and EVI vegetation indices over forest ecoregions using MODIS imagery from 2010 to 2020. It extracts mean pixel values from the MODIS/MOD13A1 collection within a forest-labeled feature collection, generates a time series chart of average index values, and displays the spatial distribution of forest regions on the map. The output is a line chart showing EVI and NDVI dynamics over time with labeled axes, colors, and styling, alongside a mapped layer of forest ecoregions.

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI and EVI time series
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI and EVI time series
Generate a time series chart of mean NDVI and EVI values from MODIS MOD13Q1 data within a specified rectangular region, based on user-input year. It also visualizes the first image of the filtered collection for both EVI and NDVI with custom color palettes on the map.

rows.title: Task: Compute GRACE-informed groundwater storage anomaly
rows.task_full:
Task: Compute GRACE-informed groundwater storage anomaly
Compute annual soil moisture (or snow water equivalent) anomalies relative to the 2003–2016 mean for three HUC-04 basins in California’s Central Valley (HUC codes 1802, 1803, 1804), using GLDAS NOAH model output. It filters the NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H ImageCollection by year and variable band (initially 'SWE_inst', but commented to be adjustable to 'SM_inst'), calculates the long-term mean image, then derives a single-year anomaly image (e.g., 2003 minus mean), sets temporal and metadata properties, and exports it as an Earth Engin

rows.title: Task: Classify land use with CART
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land use with CART
the workflow performs a supervised land use and land cover classification using Sentinel-2 imagery and a CART classifier. It trains and tests the model on stratified samples derived from a reference land cover image, evaluates accuracy using a confusion matrix, and outputs a classified land use map with a visual legend for the regions of Caqueza and Fomeque in Colombia.

rows.title: Task: Identify land cover clusters
rows.task_full:
Task: Identify land cover clusters
Identify land cover clusters using K-means classification on Sentinel-2 bands (B8, B4, B3, B2) within a specified AOI, visualizing distinct land surface classes based on spectral reflectance. It also computes NDVI to analyze vegetation and detect possible landslide zones through thresholding.

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover into eucalyptus monoculture, crops, water, and other vegetation using a Random Forest classifier trained on Sentinel-2 surface reflectance data with NDVI and TCI bands. The output is a classified image map with visualized NDVI and true-color layers for reference.

rows.title: Task: Identify open water areas
rows.task_full:
Task: Identify open water areas
Identify open water areas by combining Sentinel-1 VH polarization backscatter analysis with Sentinel-2 mNDWI and NDVI seasonal trends. It computes harmonic regression models on time-series Sentinel-2 data to derive phase, amplitude, and median values for mNDWI and NDVI, then fuses S1-based water detection with S2-derived water indices to generate a consensus open water mask. Final outputs include seasonality composites, multi-temporal Sentinel-2 medians, and binary water/land masks based on multi-sensor agreement.

rows.title: Task: Assess frost impact on agriculture
rows.task_full:
Task: Assess frost impact on agriculture
the workflow assesses the impact of frost events on agricultural areas in the Junín region of Peru during December 2022. It uses MODIS-derived nighttime land surface temperature (LST) to detect frost conditions (LST < 0°C), masks an agricultural land cover map to identify affected croplands, computes the affected agricultural area per district using pixel area summation, and appends this as a 'HELADA' attribute to district features. Outputs include a feature collection with frost-affected agricultural area (in hectares) per district, a table chart visua

rows.title: Task: Analyze NDVI in key area and buffer
rows.task_full:
Task: Analyze NDVI in key area and buffer
Analyze NDVI values within the Tarim River region and its 10km buffer using MODIS MOD13Q1 data from 2019 to 2020, generating a maximum NDVI composite and two DOY (day of year) time series charts for the core region (maximum reduction) and surrounding buffer (mean reduction).

rows.title: Task: Map S1 backscatter over ROI
rows.task_full:
Task: Map S1 backscatter over ROI
Compute median Sentinel-1 GRD backscatter intensity over a user-defined region of interest (ROI) named 'shackleton' in Antarctica, using HH-polarized EW-mode data from a 10-day period in November 2019. It clips the imagery to the ROI and exports individual tiles of the composite image to Google Drive, based on a pre-defined Antarctic grid system filtered to ice shelves. The output includes a clipped median SAR image visualized with an ice-specific colormap, exported tile images at 30m resolution, and map layers showing ice shelves, tiling grids, and auxiliary

rows.title: Task: Compare urban expansion over time
rows.task_full:
Task: Compare urban expansion over time
Analyze changes in surface reflectance between December 2015 and a recent 10-day period using Sentinel-2 imagery over Kedougou. It retrieves two image collections: one for a specific historical period (December 2015) with multiple bands including visible, NIR, and SWIR for potential land cover analysis, and another for a recent period using only RGB bands to visualize current conditions. The workflow includes cloud filtering, spatial subsetting to Kedougou, and visualization of start and end composites. Outputs include layered visualizations of the start

rows.title: Task: Generate surface reflectance from TOA
rows.task_full:
Task: Generate surface reflectance from TOA
the workflow retrieves top-of-atmosphere (TOA) imagery from Landsat 7, Landsat 8, and Sentinel-2, then applies the SIAC atmospheric correction algorithm to generate surface reflectance (BOA - Bottom of Atmosphere) images for comparison. It visualizes the original TOA and corrected BOA results for Sentinel-2 using true-color composites.

rows.title: Task: Extract daily minimum temperature for cougar presence sites
rows.task_full:
Task: Extract daily minimum temperature for cougar presence sites
Extract daily minimum temperature data from the DAYMET dataset for locations where cougars are present. It filters the DAYMET V3 image collection for the period 2014–2017, selects the 'tmin' band (daily minimum temperature), clips it to a specified geometry, converts the time-series into a multiband image using toBands(), and samples pixel values at cougar presence points. Outputs include a CSV file of sampled temperature values at each cougar site and a median temperature image over the study area exported to Google Drive.

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover using Random Forest
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover using Random Forest
Classify land cover into vegetation, urban, and water classes using Sentinel-2 surface reflectance imagery from October 2020 to October 2021. It applies cloud and cloud shadow masking via the QA60 band, computes a median composite, and trains a Random Forest classifier using manually defined ground control points (GCPs). The output includes a classified raster map with three land cover types and an accuracy assessment via confusion matrix and overall training accuracy.

rows.title: Task: Project hottest-month temperature zones
rows.task_full:
Task: Project hottest-month temperature zones
the workflow projects future extreme summer temperature zones globally by computing the hottest monthly mean temperature (from tmax/tmin) for historical (2000–2005) and RCP8.5 future (2099) periods using NASA/NEX-GDDP climate model output, then extrapolates linearly to a 2300-equivalent condition (adding +17°C to 2099 hottest month), and classifies the resulting global temperature raster into 12 discrete thermal summer zones (e.g., 'Boiling', 'Hypercaneal', 'Freezing Summer') based on Celsius thresholds; outputs a discretized, paletted global raste

rows.title: Task: Classify land cover types
rows.task_full:
Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover types in Cairo using a Random Forest classifier applied to a Landsat 8 surface reflectance composite from 2018. It computes multiple spectral indices (NDVI, NDMI, MNDWI, SR, R65, R46, GCVI), trains the model using labeled regions (Water, Cropland, Sand, Urban), evaluates accuracy with a test dataset, and outputs a classified raster map with a legend and export task to Earth Engine Assets.

rows.title: Task: Extract state boundaries
rows.task_full:
Task: Extract state boundaries
Filter a feature collection of Brazilian states (from IBGE 2019) to select only Maranhão (CD_UF='21') and Tocantins (CD_UF='17'). It then prints the resulting feature collection and adds it to the map as a layer. The output is a geographic boundary layer of two specific Brazilian states for visualization and further spatial analysis.
